protocol.name: serenity_window_server_v1
protocol.copyright: Copyright (c) 2026, the Serenity Desktop Environment developers. SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
protocol.description: Private protocol between the Serenity WindowServer (serenity-window-server) and the Serenity Desktop Environment's shell services (the WindowManagerServer shim). It carries the state the Serenity WindowServer protocol exposes to the WindowManagerServer but that has no wlroots/standard equivalent.

interface.name: serenity_window_server_v1
interface.description: A single global, bound by the shell's WindowManagerServer shim.

request.name: set_applet_area_position

description.summary: place the applet area at a global position

request.description: Sent by the shell once it has sized its applet-area container; the WindowServer positions the applet windows within that area.

event.name: applet_area_size_changed

description.summary: the total size of the laid-out applet area

event.description: Emitted when the set of applets (or their sizes) changes, before the shell reports the area position.
